title: calliandra purpurea
intro: Calliandra purpurea, commonly known as Powder Puff, is a flowering plant native to Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Powder Puff, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects. The plant's extracts have been used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, gastrointestinal problems, and skin infections.
